occlusion_protocol: Strict adversarial occlusion: the decisive feature is maximally hidden in all four question-owned views.
scope: Final-B-Rep-derived categorical labels and image-only visual/spatial reasoning. No code, measurements, dimensions, or modeling history are released to an evaluator.
question_variant: same V4 stems and ground-truth answers, six labeled choices A-F
ground_truth_answer_format: A-F label followed by exact answer text
